title: AgiBot Unveils Four New Products at WAIC 2026
summary: AgiBot unveiled four new products at the World Artificial Intelligence Conference 2026 in Shanghai on July 18: the A3 Ultra full-size humanoid, the X2 EDU education platform, the G2 Max industrial task robot, and the OmniHand 3 Ultra-M dexterous hand. The A3 Ultra stands 1.74 meters tall, weighs 60 kg, has 51 active degrees of freedom, a 5 kg per-arm payload, and up to eight hours of runtime, powered by NVIDIA Thor for onboard embodied-AI processing. The OmniHand 3 Ultra-M packs 20 active degrees of freedom and integrated tactile sensing into a 630-gram direct-drive hand with +/-0.2 mm repeatability and a 5 kg whole-hand grip load. AgiBot also disclosed an industrial deployment with Longcheer Technology, where G2 robots run a closed-loop tablet quality-inspection line supporting roughly 3,000 units per shift with downtime kept below 4%.
whyItMatters: AgiBot is one of China's highest-volume humanoid manufacturers, having passed 15,000 cumulative robots produced by June 2026, so a coordinated four-product launch spanning a full-size humanoid, an education platform, an industrial task robot, and a dexterous hand signals a push to cover the full stack from research to factory floor. The Longcheer production-line figures, sustained multi-thousand-unit shifts with low downtime, are a more concrete measure of real-world readiness than typical demo videos, positioning AgiBot alongside Unitree as a leading indicator of how fast embodied AI is moving from lab to production line in China.
